attribution_limitations: Only the Discussion calls the cyst infected ("The patient discussed here"); the case report gives no infection finding, test, treatment or time.
Levothyroxine dose is printed as 150 mg in both the abstract and the case report; unit kept as printed.
The 5 × 8 mm midline lesion on follow-up ultrasound is not explicitly named as the previously diagnosed cyst, and the CT lesion is only "suggestive of a TGDC".
The follow-up examination, ultrasound, CT and thyroid function tests have no stated time and no individual results beyond "unremarkable".

The Discussion states that neck and chest CT was the next step after the Bethesda VI FNA report; this is taken as the single preoperative CT described in the case report, which itself names only "Computed tomography (CT)". The CT body site and the FNA-before-CT order rest on that identification.
